en: The postcard features a color photograph of a modernist, low-rise three-story hotel building surrounded by lush greenery and flowerbeds. The architecture is typical of Eastern European mid-20th century resorts. The reverse side contains multilingual text, referencing Varna (Варна), a resort named 'Druzhba' (Friendship) and Hotel 'Prostor'. There are also Cyrillic stamps and handwritten numbers.
